name: IronLog MBE
subtitle: Personal training tracker for Mr Big Evolution
description:
IronLog MBE — a fitness tracking PWA for Mr Big Evolution gym. Routes sets to sub-muscles, body-map SVG, honest volume math (primary 1.0, secondaries bonus). This SideStore source lets you install the native iOS build without using one of your 3 free-dev profile slots.

Owned by Oliver (Wingzii). Source: github.com/Wingzii/IronLog. Update flow: say 'deploy ironlog' in a session and I rebuild + push here.

apps.localizedDescription: IronLog MBE is a fitness tracking PWA built for Mr Big Evolution gym. Tracks sets, routes them to sub-muscles via a body-map SVG, computes honest volume (primary 1.0 + secondary bonus, never partitioned). Built as a multi-mirror Capacitor app — web PWA, native iOS shell, offline-first.
